title: Baltic Assembly to meet in Tallinn
summary_full: The Baltic Assembly will discuss security of the Baltic States and strengthening defence cooperation when members and Speakers of the Parliaments and representatives of the governments of the Baltic States will gather in Tallinn, Estonia, for the 45th Session of the Baltic Assembly and the 32nd Baltic Council.
